name: Kochava
description: Kochava is a mobile measurement and marketing platform for attribution, analytics, fraud prevention, campaign management, audience activation, smart links, and data feeds. Advertisers and publishers use it to understand and optimize acquisition and engagement across applications and media partners.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated Kochava API key; agents can list a redacted first page of internal app references through the limited App Management selector.

credentialRequirements.name: KOCHAVA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Kochava API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated least-privilege Kochava API key. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the Authentication-Key header to apps.api.kochava.com.

capabilities.label: Read app references
capabilities.description: Read page 1 of at most 25 internal app IDs, platform labels, and deleted states with all other app detail excluded.

approvalRequired.label: List Kochava app references
approvalRequired.description: Return at most 25 validated internal app ID/platform/deleted references plus next-page presence without token value.

blocked.label: Access app identity, configuration, or credentials
blocked.description: Names, GUIDs, package/path/store IDs, icons, account IDs, SDK/integration/session/traffic/consent flags, events, clusters, Twilio/AWS values, API context, and credentials remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access attribution, device, or reporting data
blocked.description: Users, devices, advertising IDs, IPs, locations, clicks, impressions, installs, events, campaigns, partners, revenue, cost, fraud, audiences, reports, raw data, and exports remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer Kochava
blocked.description: Apps, campaigns, links, groups, postbacks, reports, schedules, queries, audiences, credentials, users, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary apps, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, selectors, page tokens, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded app-reference read requires approval; identity, configuration, credentials, attribution, devices, reports, writes, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; key authority, fixed endpoint, redaction, caps, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed limited-selector Kochava App Management wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed limited-selector Kochava App Management wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Kochava App Management API access requires an eligible Publisher/Premium Publisher account and a customer-generated API key with app-view permission.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin confirms API entitlement, generates a dedicated least-privilege API key, and completes a live read-only limited App Management acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Kochava documents Authentication-Key App Management, GET /apps, app_selector=true limited detail, pageToken=1 for 50-result pages, pagination tokens, sensitive full-detail fields, and create/update operations.
Kochava documents customer API-key creation and account/app access implications for reporting APIs.
Kochava documents broad summary/detail/custom/device-ID reports, query SQL, S3/email delivery, app lists, report tokens, schedules, audiences, downloads, and deletion; Relay blocks these surfaces.
Kochava documents listing, creating, and modifying SmartLink groups and resources with app/account identities; Relay blocks Links API access.
Kochava documents View Apps and read-only/analyst roles alongside broader app, campaign, postback, reporting, and administration permissions.

securityNotes: The Kochava API key is encrypted and sent only in the Authentication-Key header to https://apps.api.kochava.com.
Relay allowlists only GET /apps?app_selector=true&pageToken=1, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps responses at 1 MB, returns at most 25 references, and never follows nextToken.

Output contains only internal app ID, platform, deleted state, count, and next-page presence; names, GUIDs, store/package/path/account detail, SDK/consent/configuration flags, events, embedded credentials, and token values are excluded.

Attribution, devices, campaigns, links, reports, queries, S3/email delivery, schedules, audiences, app writes, administration, arbitrary inputs/endpoints, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider setup, entitlement confirmation, key capture, role assignment, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
